newsitem.title: UK: Boots sees Do It All cash positive in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Boots sees Do It All cash positive in 1997.

text.p: British retail chemist Boots Co Plc said on Thursday it expected its loss-making home improvement chain Do It All to be cash positive in 1997 and saw it making a profit once its had eliminated poorly performing stores.
"We're pretty confident of getting this business into profit," deputy chairman and chief executive Lord Blyth told a news conference.

Boots bought out joint venture partner W.H. Smith Group Plc in June and since then has sold nine stores. It aims to keep about 133. Blyth was asked if Boots would eventually sell the business, but said there were no current plans to do so. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
